description: This file defines the ProductListActivity class in an Android application using Kotlin. It manages the UI for displaying a product list, including search, filtering, pagination, and preset management. It interacts with ViewModel for state management, updates UI components based on data and load states, and contains logic for user interactions like filters, presets, and refresh.

classes.name: ProductListActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a list of products with search, filtering, pagination, and preset functionality. It handles UI setup, user interactions, data collection from ViewModel, and state synchronization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, ViewModel, adapters, and manages lifecycle-aware data collection for paging, state, and load states.

methods.name: setupRecyclerAnimations
methods.description: Configures subtle RecyclerView item animations for better UX.

methods.name: setupPresetsAndClearAll
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for resetting filters, saving, applying, and deleting preset configurations.

methods.name: setupSearchAndFilters
methods.description: Configures search input, category spinner, and price chips filtering UI components.

methods.name: syncFilterControlsToState
methods.description: Synchronizes UI filter controls to match the current active search and filter state, especially when presets are applied.

methods.name: renderActiveFilterChips
methods.description: Displays current filters as removable chips and handles their removal actions.

methods.name: showSavePresetDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog for the user to save the current filters and search query as a named preset.

methods.name: showPresetsDialog
methods.description: Displays a list of saved presets allowing user to apply or delete them.

methods.name: showPresetActionDialog
methods.description: Allows user to apply or delete a selected preset.

methods.name: confirmDeletePreset
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog before deleting a preset.

methods.name: updateEmptyStateText
methods.description: Updates UI text for empty state messages based on current search/filter states.
